subject: Fix long-running clang-format after running integration tests (#1406)
reason: The change modifies only the format() function in build.sh, adding a -prune for .build* directories so clang-format skips build artifacts after integration tests. It is a developer-tooling/build-script fix with no change to any module source file, command, reply, persistence, or replication path, so no runtime behaviour exists to test and no scenario is needed.
